summary: Allseas is offshore pipelay company, founded in 1985. Type: private company. About 2,500 employees (Wikidata). Recognised visa sponsor (IND). 100% of its 4 jobs here don't ask for Dutch.

insights.one_liner: Offshore engineering contractor with big Delft roots and a startup-style R&D team in Eindhoven; IND recognised sponsor with an openly international vibe.

culture.text: Builds and runs its own fleet for offshore pipelay, heavy lift, deep-sea nodule collection and river waste clean-up; about 3,083 staff.
Staff often come from TU Delft, Rotterdam UAS, The Hague UAS and Twente, mostly mechanical, electrical and maritime engineers.
The Eindhoven R&D office calls itself a small, startup-inspired team building offshore inspection equipment.
Employees describe a diverse team with lots of independence and responsibility, even as students.

open.text: Allseas Engineering B.V. and Allseas Welding Services B.V. are IND recognised visa sponsors.
Staff stories describe an open, international vibe with people of many cultures and backgrounds.

growth.text: Started building a new heavy-transport vessel for offshore wind megaprojects.
Won the contract to install the subsea section of Canada's Prince Rupert gas pipeline.

worth_knowing.text: Plans to replace its whole fleet of underwater robots (ROVs) with electric-hybrid ones.
